## What you are building

The second half of TODO.md **P4**: the run that turns an alignment plus a
Reconstruction Region into a `masks/` folder inside the COLMAP dataset step 4
trains on. This is the branch `rc_alpha.deliver_masks` already names and refuses
to walk — "masks in RS's own geometry have to come from RS itself (Reconstruction
Region + mesh), which this app does not drive yet". This is that.

It is also the only mask route for a project that started from a **video**, where
there was never an alpha channel to begin with.

**Step 4 does not change.** `step_lfs.dataset_masks` already finds
`<dataset>/masks/` and sends `--mask-mode` only when the dataset really carries
masks. Do not touch it, and check at the end that you did not have to.

## What SESSION 12 left you

```
projects/<slug>/
├── region/
│   ├── region.rsbox      the box the user placed (RS's own frame). May be absent.
│   ├── region.json       the same box in the NeRF frame + provenance
│   └── region_auto.rsbox what -setReconstructionRegionAuto produced
└── rc_output/
    └── <slug>.rsproj     the saved alignment — `rc.save_project`, on by default
```

`backend/core/steps/rc_region.py` parses and writes `.rsbox`. If `region.rsbox`
is missing, the project's own automatic region is already inside the `.rsproj`
and the mask run simply does not send a `-setReconstructionRegion` — say so in
the log rather than failing.

## The shape of the run

A **second RealityScan process**, not a longer step 3: the mesh is minutes, and
nobody wants to re-align to change a mask. Model it on `/api/pipeline/analyze`,
which is the existing precedent for "re-run one phase without redoing the
expensive one" (CLAUDE.md §6.3):

* `POST /api/pipeline/masks` in `api/routes/pipeline.py` — same body shape as
  `/analyze`, same 404 / archived-409 / already-running-409 guards, same
  `_running_tasks` registration so the one-job-at-a-time rule and the abort
  button keep working.
* `run_mask_generation(project_id, settings)` in `core/pipeline_runner.py`,
  modelled on `run_analysis_only`: it drives `step_status["3"]`, catches
  `ProcessAborted` / `asyncio.CancelledError` by name, and demotes on exit.
* `backend/core/steps/step_masks.py` for the work itself — no FastAPI,
  `broadcast_fn` injected, like every other step module.
* Broadcast under the step name **`masks`**, mapped to wizard step 3 in the
  frontend store exactly as `curate` maps to step 2. Add `masks` to
  `ProgressBar`'s step-name map at the same time — that map was missing `curate`
  once already and the bar never turned green (CLAUDE.md §12, 2026-08-23).

## The script

Verbs read off the installed RealityScan 2.2
(`Help/en-US/appbasics/allcommands.htm`), not guessed:

```
-load "<rc_output>/<slug>.rsproj"
-set "mvsPreviewDownscaleFactor=…"                    # the quality knobs, see below
[-setReconstructionRegion "<region>/region.rsbox"]    # only if the user placed one
-calculatePreviewModel | -calculateNormalModel | -calculateHighModel
-selectAllImages
-generateMaskFromMesh
-exportMapsAndMask "<rc_output>/rs_masks" "<rc_output>/mask_export_params.xml"
[-save "<rc_output>/<slug>.rsproj"]                   # keep the mesh for a re-export
-clearCache
-quit
```

Notes that are not optional:

* `-load MyProject.rsproj [recoverAutosave|deleteAutosave]` is the real
  signature. If the `.rsproj` is missing, fail with a sentence naming the path
  and telling the user to re-run step 3 with `rc.save_project` on — do not
  silently re-align.
* `-generateMaskFromMesh` — "Generate mask images out of the existing camera
  views (images) and selected model. Everything around the model as seen from
  the camera will be masked out."
* `-exportMapsAndMask folderName params.xml` — "Export masks generated from the
  camera view over the model, along with depth and normal maps **for the
  selected images**." Hence `-selectAllImages` before it; without it the export
  is empty or partial and RS will not say so.
* `-selectModel modelName` exists if the freshly calculated model turns out not
  to be the selected one. Check, do not assume; RS names models itself.
* RS **skips an export it dislikes without failing the script** — that is the
  `err:5617` failure mode of the COLMAP export (CLAUDE.md §12, 2026-08-23). So
  whatever this writes must be counted and checked afterwards, exactly like
  `check_colmap_export` does.

## The params XML — `backend/core/steps/rc_mask_params.py`

The user's manual workflow uses the **"PNG and EXR" / Export maps and mask**
dialog. Its settings file is the same `<Configuration id="…"><entry key= value=/>`
shape as the COLMAP one — build it the same way `rc_export_params.py` builds
that one, and read that module's docstring first: it explains why a `<format>`
shape fails with `err:5617`, and that **values are not validated on load**, so a
wrong enum token is ignored rather than refused and shows up only as output that
does not match the request.

The key family was recovered from `RealityScan.exe`'s string table and matches
the dialog one for one:

| Dialog field | Key |
|---|---|
| Export image list / file name | `eiExportImageList`, `eiExportImageListFileName` (`imageList.txt`) |
| Export file naming | `eiExportFileNaming` |
| Export masks | `eiExportMasks` (`eiExportMasksOrDepths` gates the pair) |
| Export camera depths | `eiExportDepths`, `eiExportDistanceScale` |
| Project distance unit | `eiPlaneDistanceUnits` |
| Near / far plane distance | `eiNearPlaneDistance`, `eiFarPlaneDistance` |
| Export camera normals | `eiExportNormals`, `eiExportCameraNormalsFormat`, `eiExportWorldNormalsFormat`, `eiExportNormalFormat` |
| image quality / replace existing / extension | `eiImageQuality`, `eiReplaceExisting`, `eiExt` |
| the whole **Undistortion settings** block | the shared `undist*` / `undistort*` family — the same keys `rc_export_params.py` already emits |

JB's screenshot of the dialog is the ground truth for the values: masks **Yes**,
camera depths **No**, camera normals **No**, undistort images **Yes**, fit
**Inner region**, resolution **Fit**, downscale **1**, undistort principal point
**Yes**, image cut-out **1.0**, max count of pixels **2 000 000**, naming
**Original File Name**.

**Ask JB to save that dialog's settings to an XML once** ("the parameters file
can be exported from the export dialog for maps and masks") and drop it in
`docs/rs/`. `rc_export_params.verify_against_saved_params()` already exists for
exactly this comparison — point it at the file and settle the key names before a
real run settles them the expensive way. Do this first; it is ten minutes and it
is the difference between one run and five.

## The two things this feature stands or falls on

### 1. Geometry — the same trap, one step further along

`-generateMaskFromMesh` renders each *camera's* view, and the cameras are the
**source** images; the COLMAP dataset holds RS's **undistorted crops** of them,
and RS crops every image differently (3793×2835 next to 3785×2831 from one
uniform source — CLAUDE.md §7.2). A mask of the wrong geometry is worse than no
mask: it deletes real surface, keeps background, and LichtFeld Studio refuses it
outright (`Mask '{}' is {}x{} but image '{}' is {}x{}`).

The answer is to make the mask export undistort **through the same block** as the
COLMAP export. Do not hand-type a second default set: have `rc.masks.undistort`
default to *the COLMAP block's own values* at run time and log any field where
the two differ. Note that JB's dialog screenshot has `max_pixels = 2 000 000`
where `defaults.json`'s COLMAP undistort has `0` — that one mismatch alone would
downscale every mask and fail the dimension check.

Then verify, on a real project (`riverbed_002-v2` or `fauteuil3d_test`), that a
mask's pixel dimensions equal its image's. If they do not, this route is worth
much less and the finding is the deliverable — say so instead of shipping masks
that LFS will refuse.

### 2. Naming — the masks must land on the COLMAP image names

Measured on disk today: the COLMAP export writes `images/00000.png`,
`00001.png`… because `rc.colmap.undistort.naming_convention` is `sequential`
(`undistortNamingConvention = "00000"`). The mask dialog is set to **Original
File Name** (`$(imageName)`), so RS's masks come out as `frame_0001.png`. LFS
pairs `masks/<stem>.png` with `images/<stem>.png`; those two sets do not meet.

Three routes, in order of preference — decide by measurement, not by argument:

1. **Set both exports to `original` naming.** One field, and it also restores
   name matching in the alignment coverage check, which has been falling back to
   export order since 2026-08-20 precisely because RS renames. Re-run step 3 once
   and confirm nothing downstream cares (`cameras.py`, `alignment_check.json`,
   `colmap_dataset.py`, the preview).
2. **Set both to sequential** — only if the mask exporter's counter provably runs
   over the same image set in the same order.
3. **Pair by position**, with the count-and-dimension guard `rc_alpha.deliver_masks`
   already implements, and turn `eiExportImageList` on so `imageList.txt` makes
   the order explicit and checkable rather than assumed.

Whatever you pick, the delivery reuses `rc_alpha`'s existing checks — count
first, then dimensions, then names — and refuses rather than pairing a mask with
the wrong image. Extend that module (it is where the checks live and where the
"RS has to make them" note points) rather than writing a second copy of them.

## Settings and UI

New `rc.masks` block in `defaults.json` and `RCDefaults`:

```python
class MaskDefaults(BaseModel):
    enabled: bool = False                 # a mesh inside step 3 is minutes, not seconds
    mesh_quality: Literal["preview", "normal", "high"] = "preview"
    use_region: bool = True               # send region.rsbox when it exists
    save_project_after: bool = True       # keep the mesh so a re-export is cheap
    undistort: UndistortDefaults          # seeded from rc.colmap.undistort
    # -set keys, from Help/en-US/tutorials/setkeyvaluetable.htm, "Reconstruction Settings"
    preview_downscale: int = 4            # mvsPreviewDownscaleFactor  (RS default 4)
    normal_downscale: int = 2             # mvsNormalDownscaleFactor   (RS default 2)
    gpu_acceleration: bool = True         # MvsGeometryGpuAccel
```

`-calculateHighModel` on a 300-image 4K project is not minutes. Default to
preview quality, expose the choice, and say in the panel what each costs.

UI, in `Step3_RC.tsx` (this is JB's stated UX):

1. a **"Generate masks"** toggle in the step-3 settings — when on, step 3's
   `.rscmd` already sets the automatic region (SESSION 12);
2. after the alignment ends, the sparse cloud loads in the viewer as it does
   today, with the region box editable (SESSION 12);
3. once the user validates the box, a **"Generate the masks"** button fires
   `POST /api/pipeline/masks`;
4. the mesh/mask settings live in the setup panel's RealityScan section, next to
   the COLMAP export block;
5. when it finishes: how many masks were written, at what dimensions, whether
   they matched the dataset images, and where they landed.

`rc_progress.py` plans from the script `build_rscmd` wrote (CLAUDE.md §15.3), so
the mask script needs the same treatment: teach `plan_from_script` the new verbs,
give `load`, `calculatePreviewModel` / `NormalModel` / `HighModel`,
`generateMaskFromMesh` and `exportMapsAndMask` entries in `WEIGHTS` and `LABELS`,
and add their task ids to `KIND_BY_TASK_ID` **once you have measured them** —
they are unknown today, and an unmeasured id falls through to the by-kind ordinal,
which is the safe behaviour. The mesh is the long pole; weight it accordingly and
correct the numbers from the first real run.

## Verification before you call it done

1. `-writeProgress` reports through the whole mask run and the bar moves.
2. `rs_masks/` is not empty, and its images' dimensions equal the COLMAP
   images' dimensions.
3. `<slug>_COLMAP/masks/` ends up with one mask per image, named to match.
4. Step 4, unchanged, logs `--mask-mode` being sent and does not warn about
   missing masks — and the trained splat has the background gone.
5. A reset of step 3 clears the masks with `rc_output/` and leaves `region/`
   alone.
6. Abort during the mesh kills the RealityScan tree (`core/proc.py`) and the step
   ends `aborted`, not `running`.
